messages:
zoe: Tiny survey: if our office LLMs were pets, what would they be? I'm starting a sticker idea. :dog:

harry: I'm picturing a sleepy corgi that hoards context windows. "Context-Corgi".

mina: mine's a goldfish that repeats the last thing you said but somehow wiser. "EchoFish". :fish:

leo: vote with emoji: :dog: for Context-Corgi, :fish: for EchoFish, :cat: for Cache-Cat (soft paws, stores prefixes), :hamster: for Quant-Hamster (tiny but mighty).

dock-bot: dock-bot: automatic suggestion: "Latency-Llama" with a dramatic spit when overloaded. :llama:

zoe: :dog: from me. also propose pet-care guidelines: "Never ask pets to summarize release notes after midnight."

harry: we need an official adoption form. fields: Name for model-pet, Best Snack (coffee grounds?), Allergy to hallucinations?

mina: also training tip: never feed them ambiguous prompts without a leash (clarifying Qs).

leo: idea: create a tiny "pet adoption" Slack app that posts a GIF and a badge when you adopt a model-pet.

dock-bot: dock-bot: scheduled task created: generate 5 pet GIFs from design channel assets. :robot_face:

zoe: consensus so far: Context-Corgi leads with the most :dog: reactions. EchoFish is sneaky in second.

harry: bonus mechanic: if your pet hallucinates, you owe it a real snack and a heartfelt apology in thread. :cookie:

mina: I'm making a sticker sheet draft. Anyone want their name on a sticker as "Official Pet Caretaker"?

leo: I'll take "Hamster-Wrangler" if Quant-Hamster becomes a thing.

zoe: closing the poll tomorrow. For now, ritual sign-off: "never feed the pets after 6pm" :crescent_moon:
